title: Deep contextualized word representations
summary: Matthew E. Peters, Mark Neumann, Mohit Iyyer, Matt Gardner, Christopher Clark, Kenton Lee and Luke Zettlemoyer submitted Deep contextualized word representations on February 15, 2018. The paper introduced deep contextualized word representations learned from the internal states of a deep bidirectional language model and described improvements across six NLP tasks when the representations were added to existing models.
significance: A documented research milestone for contextual word representations in natural-language processing, recorded at the original paper-submission level rather than as an invention, software-release, model-family-birth, development-start, universal-priority or causal-influence claim.
